title: fix(service-automation): a corrupt correlation cycle back to the resumed run no longer names that run as its own child
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DG3gN5hhvu8HEmLydwk8EsW)_
Part of #27971 — this PR carries the rider (comment 6516883756) and the docs half only. The card's main fix (recording a cancelled `map` item on a parent-id resume) waits on the maintainer's ruling (decision analysis 6523020455) and is not in this PR.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names neither `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` nor map cancellation; under `content/docs/**` the code appears only in the generated `references/api/` pages (automation-api, contract, error-code-ledger), which already list it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:恢复闸门沿关联 run 链往下走时，先把调用方自己的 run 记为已访问；另在客户端注释、README、QA 清单补上 409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING。
- 为什么改:关联数据损坏成 A→B→A 环时，拒绝信息会让调用方去恢复它正在恢复的那个 run，指错了门。
- 风险与回滚:只影响损坏的环形关联；正常链路的遍历结果不变。回滚即还原 engine.ts 里那一行。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`(resolveSuspensionChain 的 seen 初值)、`src/map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts`(新环形用例)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地。#27971 主修复的形状另在卡上等你裁决。

## What changes

- **Rider 6516883756.** `resolveSuspensionChain` (`service-automation/src/engine.ts`) seeds its `seen` set with the caller's run id before the walk. A corrupt correlation cycle A → B → A used to yield the chain `[A, B, A]`, and the `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` refusal then told the caller to resume A, the run it was already resuming. The chain now ends at B and the refusal names B.
- **Docs half.** `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` is added to the client `resume()` docblock's list of refusals that leave the suspension intact (`packages/client/src/index.ts`), to the service-automation README's code list, and to the automation checklist item `automation.trigger-status-contract` (acceptance[4], a new variant row, history revision 9).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-automation` patch.

## Tests

- New pin in `map-parent-resume-refusal.test.ts`: *names the item run, never the caller's own, when a corrupt correlation cycles back to the caller*. It points the item's row back at its parent (`map:PARENT`), resumes the parent, and asserts the code, that the message names the item run and not the parent, and that the map state did not move.
- Ablation (fix committed first; the test imports `./engine.js` from `src`, so no `dist` is on the path): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the seeded constructor with an empty one (anchor x1 → x0, blob c3ff057c → 43ab85a7); the new pin went red (1 failed, 5 passed); the restore matched the HEAD blob c3ff057c and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on `main` f6adf480 for the card's main half (not changed here): after `cancelRun` on a parked map item, a parent-id resume advances past it. The parent completes, a downstream node sees `results` holding only item 2's output, and `count` is 1.
- No stock showcase flow reaches `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`: `showcase_release_signoff`'s item parks on an approval, which answers 403 first. The new checklist variant says so.
